clients.title: Use with other clients
clients.v03: Testing against this server from librespeed-cli, an OpenSpeedTest™ web UI or Apple networkQuality arrives in BitGauge v0.3.

methodology.title: How it measures
methodology.summary: Download and upload run over one or more HTTP streams; the warm-up is discarded and the rate is the average over the steady window that follows. Idle latency and jitter come from pings over WebSocket, or over HTTP when WebSocket is unavailable. Every result also reports the data used and the duration.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: No accounts, no tracking, no ads. The server keeps no results: a result exists only in this browser.
